en.g: Tell a vivid story about your best trip with narrative tenses and strong adjectives.
p: Set the scene with the past continuous: The sun was shining and we were walking along the beach.
Main events in the past simple, earlier events in the past perfect: When we arrived, the bus had already left.
Swap weak words for strong ones: very good → amazing, very tired → exhausted, very beautiful → breathtaking.
en.q: What was the best trip of your life? Where did you go, and what happened that you will never forget?
en.c: Tell your best trip story in six sentences with one past continuous, one past perfect and two strong adjectives.

de.q: Was war die schönste Reise deines Lebens? Wohin ging es, und was ist passiert, das du nie vergisst?
de.c: Erzähl deine Reise in sechs Sätzen mit einem past continuous, einem past perfect und zwei starken Adjektiven.

en.g: Compare customs like personal space, punctuality and directness without stereotypes.

Avoid all and always: not All Brazilians are late, but Some people are more relaxed about time.
en.q: Which custom in another culture surprised you the most? How is it different from your own?

en.g: Describe famous festivals and traditions around the world.
p: Holi in India: people throw coloured powder. Carnival in Brazil: parades, samba and costumes.
Lantern Festival in China: lanterns light up the night. Oktoberfest in Munich: music, tents and traditional food.
Use the passive for traditions: It is celebrated in spring. Special food is prepared. It takes place every year.
en.q: What is your favourite festival? When does it take place, and how do people celebrate it?
en.c: Describe a festival from your country in four sentences, using takes place, is celebrated and people usually.

en.g: Talk about good manners and what is polite or rude in different places.

You're expected to / you're not supposed to: You're expected to take your shoes off. You're not supposed to eat on the metro.
Gerund as subject: Queuing is very important in the UK. Pointing at people is impolite in many places.

en.g: Talk about eating habits, mealtimes and table manners around the world.
p: Mealtimes differ: In Spain, dinner is often at ten. In the UK, many people eat at six or seven.

en.q: What are mealtimes and table manners like in your home? Is anything different from other countries?

en.g: Describe customs for greetings and gifts in different cultures.
p: Greetings vary: people shake hands, bow, hug or give one, two or even three kisses on the cheek.
Gift customs: in some places you open a gift right away, in others you wait. Wrapping can matter too.
Use when-clauses: When people meet for the first time, they usually shake hands.
en.q: How do people greet each other in your country? Is it different with friends, family and colleagues?
en.c: Explain to a visitor how to greet people and give a gift in your country in four sentences with when.

p: Begrüßungen sind verschieden: Händeschütteln, Verbeugen, Umarmen oder ein bis drei Wangenküsse.
Geschenke: Mancherorts öffnet man sie sofort, anderswo später. Auch die Verpackung kann wichtig sein.
Benutze when-Sätze: When people meet for the first time, they usually shake hands.
de.q: Wie begrüßt man sich in deinem Land? Ist es bei Freunden, Familie und Kollegen unterschiedlich?

es.q: ¿Cómo se saluda la gente en tu país? ¿Es distinto con amigos, familia y compañeros de trabajo?

fr.q: Comment se salue-t-on dans ton pays ? Est-ce différent entre amis, en famille et entre collègues ?
fr.c: Explique à un visiteur en quatre phrases avec when comment saluer et offrir un cadeau dans ton pays.

it.q: Come ci si saluta nel tuo paese? È diverso tra amici, in famiglia e con i colleghi?

en.g: Talk about moving abroad: settling in, culture shock and making new friends.
p: Feelings: At first I felt homesick. I missed my family. Culture shock is completely normal.
Progress with the present perfect: I've lived here for a year. I've made new friends. I haven't found a flat yet.
Tips: join a club, learn a few local phrases, say yes to invitations and stay in touch with home.
en.q: Would you like to live abroad one day? Where, and what do you think would be the hardest part?

en.g: Share language-learning strategies that really work.
p: Shadowing: listen and repeat right after the speaker. Flashcards: review a few words every day.
Language exchange: talk with a partner, half in English, half in their language. Try thinking in English too.
Advice patterns: Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
en.q: Which learning strategy has helped you the most so far? Which one would you like to try next?
en.c: Try one new strategy today, like five minutes of shadowing, and tell me in three sentences how it went.

de.g: Du teilst Strategien zum Sprachenlernen, die wirklich funktionieren.
p: Shadowing: hören und direkt nachsprechen. Flashcards: jeden Tag ein paar Wörter wiederholen.
Tandem: mit einem Partner sprechen, halb Englisch, halb seine Sprache. Versuch auch, auf Englisch zu denken.
Ratschläge: Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
de.q: Welche Lernstrategie hat dir bisher am meisten geholfen? Welche möchtest du als Nächstes ausprobieren?
de.c: Probier heute eine neue Strategie aus, z. B. fünf Minuten Shadowing, und erzähl mir in drei Sätzen, wie es war.

es.g: Comparte estrategias para aprender idiomas que funcionan de verdad.
p: Shadowing: escuchar y repetir justo después del hablante. Flashcards: repasar unas palabras cada día.
Intercambio de idiomas: hablar con alguien mitad en inglés, mitad en su idioma. Prueba también a pensar en inglés.
Consejos: Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
es.q: ¿Qué estrategia te ha ayudado más hasta ahora? ¿Cuál te gustaría probar después?
es.c: Prueba hoy una estrategia nueva, como cinco minutos de shadowing, y cuéntame en tres frases cómo te fue.

fr.g: Partage des stratégies d'apprentissage des langues qui marchent vraiment.
p: Shadowing : écouter et répéter juste après la personne. Flashcards : réviser quelques mots chaque jour.
Échange linguistique : parler moitié en anglais, moitié dans la langue de l'autre. Essaie aussi de penser en anglais.
Conseils : Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
fr.q: Quelle stratégie t'a le plus aidé jusqu'ici ? Laquelle aimerais-tu essayer ensuite ?
fr.c: Essaie une nouvelle stratégie aujourd'hui, par exemple cinq minutes de shadowing, et raconte-moi en trois phrases.

it.g: Condividi strategie per imparare le lingue che funzionano davvero.
p: Shadowing: ascoltare e ripetere subito dopo chi parla. Flashcards: ripassare qualche parola ogni giorno.
Scambio linguistico: parlare metà in inglese e metà nella lingua dell'altro. Prova anche a pensare in inglese.
Consigli: Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
it.q: Quale strategia ti ha aiutato di più finora? Quale vorresti provare dopo?
it.c: Prova oggi una strategia nuova, come cinque minuti di shadowing, e raccontami in tre frasi com'è andata.

pt.g: Partilha estratégias para aprender línguas que funcionam mesmo.
p: Shadowing: ouvir e repetir logo a seguir a quem fala. Flashcards: rever algumas palavras todos os dias.
Intercâmbio de línguas: falar metade em inglês, metade na língua do outro. Experimenta também pensar em inglês.
Conselhos: Try watching films with subtitles. It helps to read aloud. The best way to improve is to practise daily.
pt.q: Que estratégia te ajudou mais até agora? Qual gostavas de experimentar a seguir?
pt.c: Experimenta hoje uma estratégia nova, como cinco minutos de shadowing, e conta-me em três frases como correu.

pt_BR.g: Compartilhe estratégias para aprender idiomas que funcionam de verdade.
p: Shadowing: ouvir e repetir logo depois de quem fala. Flashcards: revisar algumas palavras todo dia.
Intercâmbio de idiomas: conversar metade em inglês, metade na língua do outro. Tente também pensar em inglês.

pt_BR.c: Teste hoje uma estratégia nova, como cinco minutos de shadowing, e me conte em três frases como foi.

vocab.ex: Shadowing means repeating audio right after the speaker.

target.gram: Giving advice: Try + -ing (experiment), It helps to + verb, The best way to learn is to + verb: Try shadowing for five minutes.
